column6: O king, foremost one of @wDN{An}, chosen in his holy heart, @wRN{@wDN{Samsu}-iluna}, king, foremost one of @wDN{An}, chosen in his holy heart, …… rites …… august, ……, joyful, supreme, assiduous, with head high on the gold-decorated throne of …… kingship, who sits majestically …… in its midst in heroic strength, @wRN{@wDN{Samsu}-iluna}: @wDN{An}, the mighty king of heaven, the august judge, has assigned you a great destiny, and has made you to pass your life with a secure crown.

He is the man to whom @wDN{Enlil} has given …… and the shepherdship over the widespread people, the beloved shepherd of @wSN{Nibru}, the constant servant of @wTN{E-kur}; he is the trustworthy farmer of the house of @wDN{Asalim}, who takes care that provisions do not cease in @wTN{E-saŋ-ila}. For you to exercise your divine powers of shepherdship in the Land, @wDN{Enlil} has placed the foreign lands at your feet. Obedient to @wDN{Utu}, beloved of @wDN{Inana}, @wRN{@wDN{Samsu}-iluna}, the king whose fate is never altered by @wDN{Enlil}, my king, at the command uttered by @wDN{Enlil}, @wDN{Enki} and @wDN{Asalim}, @wDN{Zababa}, @wDN{Lugal-gu-dua}, the king who builds temples, …… the rebel lands …… @gap{unknown no. of lines missing}

@wDN{Iškur}, the net of the foreign lands …… made the foreign countries praise him duly, and made the mighty …… manifest. @wRN{@wDN{Samsu}-iluna}, the good hero, lordly one of his Land, has wisely co-ordinated decisions for the Land. From the banks of the @wWN{Tigris} and the banks of the @wWN{Euphrates}, to the shores of the sea …… and the banks of its rivers, men …… @wRN{@wDN{Samsu}-iluna}. In @wTN{E-kur}, the house of @wDN{Enlil}, …… he has taken his seat on his dais of joy. @wDN{Enlil}, it is sweet to praise you. @wDN{Enlil}, give my king a brilliant destiny and years of life! Grant him as a gift a life of long days!
